prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Toshiba 22' LCD HDTV With Built In DVD Player In Black - 22LV505; brand: toshiba; description: Toshiba 22' LCD HDTV With Built In DVD Player In Black - 22LV505/  Built-In Slot Loading DVD Player/ Built-In ATSC/NTSC/QAM Digital Tuning/ Official DivX® Certified/ PC Input/ Space Saving Design/ Bottom Mount Stereo Speakers/ Black Finish

Candidates:
1. name: Toshiba 22LV506 22' TV/DVD Combo; brand: Toshiba; description: 21.9' - LCD - Active Matrix - ATSC, NTSC - 16:9 - 1680 x 1050 - - HDTV - DVD-R, DVD-RW, CD-R, CD-RW - 720p; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
2. name: Toshiba 22AV500U 22' LCD TV; brand: Toshiba; description: Toshiba 22AV500U - 22' 720p LCD HDTV w/ Built-in NTSC/ATSC Tuner - Piano Black; price: $338.99; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
3. name: Toshiba 19LV505 - 19' Widescreen LCD HDTV w/ Built-in DVD Player - 800:1 Contrast Ratio - 5ms Response Time; brand: Toshiba; check: model numbers differ, brand equal

response.text: {"reason": "The price-list item's model number 22LV505 does not match any candidate's model number exactly, but it is the closest match to candidate 1 which has a similar model number 22LV506 and is the same brand and product type.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.6}
